text: YESTERMORROW（DSH Web 插件）：为 DeepSeek Harness 网页客户端提供复古未来主义界面皮肤。它通过客户端样式、场景装饰和侧栏切换器接入，可在以太工造、霓虹夜行与落日海岸三套视觉主题间切换，并提供题词展示与刷新、快捷键换肤和本地保存选择。适合希望定制 DSH Web 工作界面外观的用户。需要 DSH Web 兼容环境；代码未定义 API 密钥或外部服务配置。

YESTERMORROW brings three retrofuturist themes to DSH Web: Aetherworks, Neon Drift and Sunset Coast. Switch them from the sidebar or keyboard, refresh the displayed quotes, and keep the chosen theme in browser storage. For users customizing their DSH workspace; no API key is defined.
想给 DSH 网页版换一套复古未来风格的界面。
能不能在 DSH Web 里切换不同主题？

How can I switch between visual themes in the DSH web client?
I want a retrofuturist look for my DSH workspace.
Can I change the DSH skin with a keyboard shortcut?
YESTERMORROW 的功能「三套主题切换」：提供以太工造、霓虹夜行和落日海岸三套主题。用户可点击侧栏底部的主题切换器，或用 Alt+1、Alt+2、Alt+3 选择主题；切换会更新皮肤标记和对应界面装饰。
YESTERMORROW 的功能「题词刷新」：在首页题词区域展示带出处的题词。用户可点击刷新按钮或按 R 更换一条；输入框、文本区和可编辑区域获得焦点时，R 不会触发刷新。
YESTERMORROW 的功能「记住主题选择」：主题切换后将所选皮肤 ID 存入浏览器 localStorage，初始化时读取此前选择；存储不可用时回退到默认主题。

@zcm/dsh-client-ui-skin-yestermorrow README · YESTERMORROW · 昨日之明日：**简体中文** · [English](README.en.md)

> 昨日想象的明日，今天的工作界面。

面向 **DeepSeek Harness Web GUI** 的复古未来主义皮肤合集。一个插件，三套风格：黄昏列车、霓虹雨夜、落日太空港。保留不同年代的材质与生活气息，把过去的人所想象的未来带进工作界面。

切换只改变视觉材质、场景与字牌，不重载页面，也不改变当前会话、输入内容和题词。

@zcm/dsh-client-ui-skin-yestermorrow README · 以太工造 · AETHERWORKS：黄昏列车驶向远方的未来城市。黄铜、工业仪表和暖色车窗；明暗模式共用列车底图，亮色模式叠加测绘纸质感。

@zcm/dsh-client-ui-skin-yestermorrow README · 霓虹夜行 · NEON DRIFT：旧式出租车悬浮在雨夜街道，多层空中交通穿过霓虹灯牌。保留湿沥青、行人与还亮着灯的拉面店；青色与品红搭配背光玻璃。暗色专用。

@zcm/dsh-client-ui-skin-yestermorrow README · 落日海岸 · SUNSET COAST：棕榈树、镀铬车身和珊瑚色落日。远处是六十年代想象中的海上太空港、单轨交通和复古飞行器；保持海岸的开阔与宁静。暗色专用。

三套皮肤共用 22 条影视与哲学题词，逐条标注出处。切换皮肤保留当前题词，点击题词旁的圆钮或按 `R` 可换一句。

@zcm/dsh-client-ui-skin-yestermorrow README · 安装：要求：DSH Web **0.2.1-rc.2** 或兼容版本。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add 'github:Evan1987/dsh-yestermorrow#main'
```

安装完成后重启一次 DSH。之后切换皮肤即时生效，无须重启。

卸载本插件：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove '@zcm/dsh-client-ui-skin-yestermorrow'
```

@zcm/dsh-client-ui-skin-yestermorrow README · 使用：点击侧栏底部的当前皮肤名打开切换器，或使用快捷键：

| 快捷键 | 操作 |
| --- | --- |
| `Alt+1` | 以太工造 |
| `Alt+2` | 霓虹夜行 |
| `Alt+3` | 落日海岸 |
| `R` | 更换题词；输入框内不触发 |

皮肤选择保存在浏览器本地，刷新后保留。调试时可使用 `?skin=aetherworks`、`?skin=neon` 或 `?skin=sunset`。

同一 DSH profile 建议只启用一个皮肤插件，避免样式相互覆盖。

@zcm/dsh-client-ui-skin-yestermorrow README · 本地开发：```bash
git clone https://github.com/Evan1987/dsh-yestermorrow.git
cd dsh-yestermorrow
pnpm install
pnpm typecheck

- `src/client/index.ts`：挂载、切换、浏览器偏好与卸载清理。
- `src/client/skins.ts`：三套皮肤的配置；`quotes.ts`：共享题词池。
- `src/client/theme.css` 与 `src/client/skins/`：共用布局与各皮肤材质。
- `src/client/assets/`：实际使用的 WebP 背景。
- `build/build.mjs`：生成 `lib/index.js` 和 `lib/client.js`。构建产物随仓库提交，从 GitHub 安装无须再次构建。
- `tests/apply.test.mjs`：生命周期、皮肤切换、偏好迁移、题词与模块注册回归测试。

CI 在 Node 22 + pnpm 11 下运行类型检查、测试，并验证提交的构建产物与源码一致。

@zcm/dsh-client-ui-skin-yestermorrow README · 边界与许可：插件仅作用于客户端界面，不修改模型请求，不收集使用数据。CSS、WebP 与 SVG 全部内联，运行时不请求远程图片或字体。卸载会移除插件注入的界面节点和样式。

代码采用 [MIT License](LICENSE)。霓虹与海岸主图以原有底图为基础，经 AI 辅助改绘；列车底图沿用已有素材。题词仅引用文字并标注出处，不包含影视剧照或字体文件。更详细的设计记录见 [Aetherworks 文档](docs/aetherworks.md)。

@zcm/dsh-client-ui-skin-yestermorrow README · YESTERMORROW · 昨日之明日：**English** · [简体中文](README.md)

> Yesterday's visions of tomorrow, in today's workspace.

A retrofuturist skin collection for **DeepSeek Harness Web GUI**. One plugin, three settings: a dusk train, neon rain and a sunset spaceport. Each keeps the materials and everyday life of an earlier era while imagining a future that never arrived.

Switching changes the visual materials, scenery and lettering without reloading the page or changing the conversation, draft or current quote.

@zcm/dsh-client-ui-skin-yestermorrow README · Aetherworks · 以太工造：A dusk train approaches a distant future city. Brass, industrial instruments and warm carriage windows. Light and dark modes share the train photograph; light mode adds a survey-paper treatment.

@zcm/dsh-client-ui-skin-yestermorrow README · Neon Drift · 霓虹夜行：Vintage hover taxis and elevated transit weave through a rainy neon street, with wet asphalt, pedestrians and a ramen shop still open. Cyan and magenta meet backlit glass. Dark only.

@zcm/dsh-client-ui-skin-yestermorrow README · Sunset Coast · 落日海岸：Palms, chrome and a coral sunset. A Space Age offshore port, monorail and vintage spacecraft add a 1960s vision of tomorrow while keeping the coast open and peaceful. Dark only.

All three share 22 sourced film and philosophy quotes. Switching skins preserves the current quote; the round button beside it or the `R` key selects another.

@zcm/dsh-client-ui-skin-yestermorrow README · Install：Requires DSH Web **0.2.1-rc.2** or a compatible version.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add 'github:Evan1987/dsh-yestermorrow#main'
```

Restart DSH once after installing. Later skin switches apply immediately.

Uninstall:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove '@zcm/dsh-client-ui-skin-yestermorrow'
```

@zcm/dsh-client-ui-skin-yestermorrow README · Use：Open the skin switcher at the bottom of the sidebar, or use the keyboard:

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `Alt+1` | Aetherworks |
| `Alt+2` | Neon Drift |
| `Alt+3` | Sunset Coast |
| `R` | Change quote; ignored inside input fields |

The selected skin is saved locally in the browser and survives a refresh. For testing, use `?skin=aetherworks`, `?skin=neon` or `?skin=sunset`.

Enable one skin plugin per DSH profile to avoid overlapping styles.

@zcm/dsh-client-ui-skin-yestermorrow README · Local development：- `src/client/index.ts`: lifecycle, switching, browser preferences and cleanup.
- `src/client/skins.ts`: skin definitions; `quotes.ts`: shared quote pool.
- `src/client/theme.css` and `src/client/skins/`: shared layout and skin materials.
- `src/client/assets/`: the WebP backgrounds used by the plugin.
- `build/build.mjs`: generates `lib/index.js` and `lib/client.js`. Built files are committed, so installing from GitHub needs no local build.
- `tests/apply.test.mjs`: lifecycle, switching, preference migration, quotes and module registration regressions.
@zcm/dsh-client-ui-skin-yestermorrow README · Local development：CI runs type checks and tests on Node 22 + pnpm 11 and verifies that committed build output matches the source.

@zcm/dsh-client-ui-skin-yestermorrow README · Boundaries and license：This client-only plugin does not modify model requests or collect usage data. CSS, WebP and SVG are inlined, with no remote image or font requests at runtime. Uninstall removes the injected interface nodes and styles.

@zcm/dsh-client-ui-skin-yestermorrow README · Boundaries and license：Code is covered by the [MIT License](LICENSE). Neon and coast images are AI-assisted edits of the existing backgrounds; the train background is retained. Quotes are text only, with their sources noted; no film stills or font files are included.
